data.name: PathEmpty
data.value: Enter the full path of nasm.exe.

data.name: PathNotFull
data.value: The assembler path must be a full local path, such as C:\Tools\nasm\nasm.exe.

data.name: PathNotExe
data.value: The assembler must be an .exe file.

data.name: ConfiguredUnusable
data.value: The configured assembler can't be used: {0} Correct it in Settings.

data.name: NoneAvailable
data.value: No assembler is available. Set the path of nasm.exe in Settings.

data.name: BundledMissing
data.value: The bundled assembler is missing ({0}). Reinstall Assembly Studio or set the path of nasm.exe in Settings.

data.name: NotStarted
data.value: The assembler at {0} could not be started: {1}

data.name: VersionTimedOut
data.value: The assembler at {0} did not answer a version request within {1:0} s.

data.name: VersionFailed
data.value: The assembler at {0} failed when asked for its version (exit code {1}).

data.name: NoVersion
data.value: The assembler at {0} did not report a NASM version. Assembly Studio is tested with NASM {1}.

data.name: OlderVersion
data.value: NASM {0} is older than {1}, the version Assembly Studio is tested with. Builds may fail or map source lines incorrectly.
